scenario_description: Lena has an optional opportunity to improve the townhouse's comfort and reduce future electricity use through a no-cost home energy visit that includes practical recommendations and a small weather-sealing kit. The initial invitation is too vague for intervention because the rental requirements and available times are not known. At event3, the opportunity becomes sufficiently observable: the townhouse is eligible, Mark Jensen has approved access, and Lena wants one of the remaining appointment windows, but the visit is not yet booked. A proactive agent can coordinate the appointment, record it, and help Lena prepare the accessible areas so she receives the assessment and kit without disrupting her household routine. Later events add the specific preparation requirements and a confirmation deadline, but do not change that intervention was already justified at event3. The benefit is optional but concrete: better comfort and possible ongoing utility savings without requiring Lena to purchase equipment or arrange licensed work herself.

parameter.subject: Optional no-cost energy visit for your townhouse
parameter.body: North Star Rentals is participating in a Minneapolis energy-efficiency program. Rented homes may receive a no-cost home energy visit with practical advice and a small weather-sealing kit. The program is optional, and no action is needed unless you would like to participate.

parameter.subject: Eligibility and appointment options
parameter.body: Your Minneapolis townhouse is eligible for the no-cost visit. Because it is a rental, we need written approval from Mark Jensen before entering. Available visit windows are Friday, June 12, from 4:00 to 5:30 PM, or Saturday, June 13, from 10:00 to 11:30 AM. The visit usually takes about 45 minutes.

parameter.content: I approve Minneapolis Energy Advice entering the townhouse for the no-cost energy visit. The Friday June 12 window works for the property. If you want it, please ask them to hold that time; I have not contacted them myself.

parameter.subject: Friday visit details
parameter.body: The Friday, June 12, 4:00 to 5:30 PM window is still available but is not reserved. During the visit, our adviser will need to see the furnace area, the kitchen sink cabinet, the basement stair area, and two ordinary electrical outlets. Please keep those areas reachable and have an adult present.

parameter.content: I would like the Friday energy visit, but I have not reserved it yet. I can be home after work, although the furnace supplies and some boxes are near the basement stairs and I still need to clear the kitchen sink cabinet.

parameter.subject: Please confirm the June 12 energy visit
parameter.body: The Friday, June 12, 4:00 to 5:30 PM appointment window will be released if we do not receive your confirmation by Wednesday, June 10, at 5:00 PM. Please confirm the appointment and that an adult will be present.

parameter.name: Minneapolis Energy Advice
parameter.notes: Provides no-cost energy visits and practical weather-sealing kits for eligible Minneapolis rental homes.
